reads.found: CHECKED ZERO at the foot, both columns. Collated word by word against chunk 0008 (and the head of 0009 at the foot of col 430). No divergence from the twin. reads.source: CALIBRATION: corners read FIRST -- left 431, right 432; running head 'S. EGBERTI EBORACENSIS ARCHIEPISCOPI'. Overview, then crops at 300 dpi inside each column for the upper (Book IV) and lower (EX EJUSDEM…) sections, a full-width crop of the mid-page note line and division head, and 400 dpi crops of three single letters.
reads.found: ⚑ FOOT NOTE NOT AMONG THE SIX: at the foot of the UPPER section, keyed at 0432A 'quae haec opponit ª': 'ª Mallem legere : quoniam illorum matri convenit huic se opponere. WILKINS.' Not in our Latin; reported, not added (see PENDING-TEI-PATCHES-0008). The division head confirmed exactly: 'EX EJUSDEM EGBERTI POENITENTIALIS LIBRO SECUNDO / IN PUBLICA BIBLIOTHECA OXONIENSI, / SUB TITULO ª / ABHINC DIVERSA EX DIVERSIS EXCESSIBUS JUDICIA.' and its foot note 'ª De his canonibus vide superius Praemonitionem meam ad Collectiones canonicas Egberti. MANSI.' matches the injected [cn: a]. Text collated word by word against chunk 0009: agrees throughout, incl. 'quindecim hiemes', 'si sit non ordinatus', 'vel suspendatur', 'nunquam desistat, nisi die Solis', 'quoniam mater illorum conti-|git ea, quae haec opponit', 'si hoc frustra fecerit', canons I-XIII. Single-witness worn sorts, no marker, no patch: 'Domiuo' (0431C, 400 dpi), 'stiοendio' (0431D), 'subjaccbit' (0432C). Canon VII breaks 'ad ec-|clesiam' across the 431/432 column change.

reads.source: CALIBRATION: corners read FIRST -- left 433 (worn), right 434; running head 'POENITENTIALIS EXCERPTUM.' Overview, three crops per column at 300 dpi (right column re-cropped from x 1080 after the first crop clipped its left edge; gutter not crossed), foot crops, and a 400 dpi crop of the XVIII 'gradu ecclesiastico' line.
reads.found: Foot notes: 'ª Id est, populi confluentias.' 'ᵇ Vide infra cap. 32.' (left) and 'ᶜ Al., proprio excommunicetur cibo, ut supra cap. 25.' (right) -- all three match the injected [cn:]s. TWO PLATE/TWIN DIVERGENCES, both pending patches: (1) 0434B 'excitavit,' COMMA on the plate where the twin has a full stop (known from prep; confirmed); (2) 0434D italic '*De omni verbo otioso*' where the twin has 'otiosa'. Confirmed as printed: '*Hospes fui, et non recepistis me* (*Matth.* xxv)'; '*Si autem non audierit, sit nobis sicut gentilis et publicanus* (*Matth.* xviii)'; '*Perdes omnes qui loquuntur mendacium.* Et, *omne mendacium a diabolo est* (*Psalm.* v)'; 'quod locuti fuerunt homines, reddent rationem Deo in die judicii (*Matth.* ı)' -- the citation numeral is a single stroke; '*Nihil impunitum derelinquet Deus.*'; 'saepius proprio ᵇ excommunicetur cibo'. Single-witness: 'com lacrymis' (0433B, worn u). Indeterminate: whether 'in' stands before 'ecclesiastico' at 0433B (left margin blotted on this copy).

reads.source: CALIBRATION: corners read FIRST -- left 435, right 436; running head 'S. EGBERTI EBORACENSIS ARCHIEPISCOPI'. Overview plus crops of the two opening lines of each column at 300 dpi.
reads.found: Our text is only the first two lines of each column: 'respondens, et omnino quidquid contra Scriptura-|rum sacrarum auctoritatem est; secundum men-' / 'suram opusque peccati, ad sacerdotis arbitrium poe-|niteat.' Agrees with chunk 0010 ('men-|suram' broken across the 435/436 column change, where our [0436A] sits). The page then opens the NEXT work (De institutione catholica dialogus); its foot note 'ª Editus primum Dublinii 1664, opera Joan. Waraei equitis.' belongs to that work and was not read as ours.
